scope: Read-only explicit-span binding to unvalidated source-backed candidates; no semantic extraction or Memory reuse

checks.check: Changed Markdown links and code fences

verified_behaviors: Only explicit spans of a previously saved local snapshot are processed; no network, model, task state or Memory writes.
Capability and strict input validation precede source reads; source reference and expected text hash bind the selected version.
Source raw/text/manifest consistency is checked before binding; a constructed dataclass alone is not treated as trusted.
Character offsets are Unicode code points, start inclusive/end exclusive; source line numbers begin at one.
Exact quotes retain whitespace and line breaks; facts equal verbatim quotes and never become paraphrased conclusions.
One to twenty explicit spans, each at most 4000 characters; duplicate, blank, oversized or invalid spans reject the whole batch.
Candidate IDs bind source snapshot, text hash, parser version, target labels, exact spans and quote.
Mechanical integrity verification checks Source, quote, locator, line numbers and stable ID; it does not check entailment or target relevance.
Candidates remain support_status=unvalidated, facts_validated=false, with no confidence score and no existing Evidence object.
Old source dates remain unchanged when explicitly read from another task context; no freshness decision or automatic asset selection occurs.
CLI runs independently of project files and returns candidates_only; existing analyze/run/resume behavior is unchanged.

local_cli_smoke.method: Explicit local snapshot reference and caller-selected character range; no asset discovery or freshness evaluation

findings: MemoryStore stores a latest task snapshot and state events keyed by task ID; it has no entity/dimension/date asset query.
ResearchMemory has asset container fields, but the actual run/resume path only writes user conversation and optional project context.
commit replaces the latest task snapshot; events retain technical state, not full Evidence/Analysis versions.
Memory revision and schema version are not research asset versions or business freshness checks.
Tool replay prevents duplicate execution for a bound request; snapshot loading verifies immutable source integrity.
Neither replay nor explicit source-reference loading proves that an old webpage or claim is current.
lifecycle and memory_reference are fields without implemented archiving, retrieval filters or asset reference resolution.
required_future_acceptance: Match entity identity, dimension definition/version, market, product version, units and applicable time; reject ambiguous or incompatible reuse.
Record origin task, Source/Evidence version, source/text hashes and explicit reasons for accepting or refusing a reuse candidate.
Keep original fetched_at; record this task revalidation separately. TTL eligibility does not itself prove current verification.
Changed sources produce new Source/Evidence versions and superseding links; old reports continue to reference their original versions.
Preserve project/context authorization boundaries and prevent background-specific judgments from silently moving into unrelated tasks.
Refresh consumes the current task budget; restriction, quota or verification failure leaves old/unupdated status rather than a current fact.
Asset and validation histories remain immutable and recoverable across interrupted imports/refreshes without duplicate uncertain calls.
